package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_route_paths_repeated_as_raw_strings: Repeated route path literals that should be centralized or grouped more intentionally.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func SetupRoutes(r *gin.Engine) {
	r.GET("/api/v1/users", listUsers)
	r.POST("/api/v1/users", createUser)
	r.GET("/api/v1/users/:id", getUser)
	r.PUT("/api/v1/users/:id", updateUser)
	r.DELETE("/api/v1/users/:id", deleteUser)
}

func listUsers(c *gin.Context) {
	c.Redirect(http.StatusMovedPermanently, "/api/v1/users")
}

func createUser(c *gin.Context) {
	c.Header("Location", "/api/v1/users/123")
	c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, gin.H{"id": "123"})
}

func getUser(c *gin.Context) {
	logRoute("/api/v1/users/" + c.Param("id"))
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"id": c.Param("id")})
}

func updateUser(c *gin.Context) {
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"updated": "/api/v1/users/" + c.Param("id")})
}

func deleteUser(c *gin.Context) {
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"deleted": "/api/v1/users/" + c.Param("id")})
}

func logRoute(path string) {}
